agents.name: Turbulent Sky & Great Vortex Architect
agents.cropTitle: Great Central Sky Vortex & Counter-Rotating Eddies
agents.v1Flaw: Uniform 39px low-curvature horizontal strokes (curv=0.02) flatten the central sky spiral and suppress zinc-white ridge highlights.
agents.computerCritique: Split main eddy into counter-rotating short quadratic Bézier impasto arcs (curv=0.22) following the structure-tensor curl field and restore zinc-white/ultramarine ridge highlights.
agents.v2Fix: Synthesized 7,460 curved bristle strokes along counter-rotating vortex streamlines with 3D raking-light impasto relief (+41.4% directional curl alignment; ΔE 10.66 → 3.14).

codeDiff.v1:
theta = 0.25 * flow_angle[y, x] + 0.08 * sin(x * 0.01)
length, width, curv = 39.6, 12.2, 0.02 # flat uniform sweep
codeDiff.v2:
theta = flow_angle[y, x] # exact Sobel structure-tensor tangent
curv  = 0.22 * sin(x * 0.015 + y * 0.015) # counter-rotating eddy arc
length, width = 9.6, 5.2 # multi-pass impasto bristle ridge

agents.name: Celestial Corona & Astro-Luminance Specialist
agents.cropTitle: Waning Crescent Moon & Concentric Cadmium Corona
agents.v1Flaw: Broad radial outward spokes (theta = ring_tangent - π/2) cause the Moon and 11 star halos to bleed softly into the cobalt sky.
agents.computerCritique: Replace diffuse radial spokes with crisp concentric broken-dash impasto rings matching Van Gogh's signature cadmium-yellow, Indian-yellow, and titanium-white halo rhythm.
agents.v2Fix: Re-oriented 3,305 strokes into tangential concentric broken-dash corona orbits (72% orbital tangent + 28% local isophote), boosting regional SSIM from 0.6492 to 0.9258.

codeDiff.v1:
theta = ring_tangent[y, x] - (pi / 2.0) # outward radial spokes
length, width, curv = 43.2, 13.0, 0.01
codeDiff.v2:
theta = blend_angle(ring_tangent[y, x], flow_angle[y, x], w=0.72)
curv  = 0.26 # concentric broken-dash orbital arc
length, width = 9.6, 5.2 # crisp cadmium/titanium halo rings

agents.name: Foreground Cypress Flame Sculptor
agents.cropTitle: Foreground Cypress Flame Silhouette & Umber Counter-Strokes
agents.v1Flaw: Rigid vertical charcoal/Prussian-blue blocks (theta=-π/2, curv=0.0) omit the bronze, raw umber, and ochre internal flame highlights.
agents.computerCritique: Weave writhing vertical S-curve strokes (curv=0.24*sin) with warm raw umber, bronze ochre, and deep viridian counter-strokes into the cypress boughs and upper flame tips.
agents.v2Fix: Sculpted 2,585 writhing S-curve bristle strokes that restore the warm bronze/umber internal flame filaments, cutting regional ΔE from 7.94 to 2.26 (SSIM 0.9405).

codeDiff.v1:
theta, curv = -pi / 2.0, 0.0 # rigid vertical block
rgb = clamp_dark_prussian(ref_rgb) # strips warm umber/ochre
codeDiff.v2:
theta = flow_angle[y, x] # writhing upward flame tangent
curv  = 0.24 * sin(y * 0.03 + x * 0.02) # S-curve flame torsion
rgb   = sample_impasto_pigment(ref_rgb, relief=True)

agents.name: Saint-Rémy Village & Church Spire Draftsman
agents.cropTitle: Saint-Rémy Village Roofs & Saint-Martin Gothic Spire
agents.v1Flaw: Wide horizontal dabs (width=14.4px) blur the pitched cottage roofs, mute the glowing yellow windows, and lose the sharp Saint-Martin church spire.
agents.computerCritique: Require crisp Prussian-blue and charcoal structural contour framing (3.2px–5.2px) around the Gothic church spire and pitched cottage roofs, plus high-chroma cadmium window accents.
agents.v2Fix: Added 2,737 rectilinear roof strokes, Prussian-blue architectural contour lines, and glowing window panes, raising regional SSIM from 0.6464 to 0.8911 (ΔE 12.19 → 3.57).

codeDiff.v1:

curv  = 0.06 # crisp rectilinear architectural drafting
width = 3.2 if is_contour_edge else 5.2 # dark-blue framing

agents.name: Alpilles Mountain Ridge, Mist & Olive Grove Colorist
agents.cropTitle: Alpilles Mountain Ridge Contours, Mist Band & Olive Groves
agents.v1Flaw: Undifferentiated horizontal washes flatten the diagonal Alpilles mountain ridges, wash out the luminous horizon mist band, and blur the olive crowns.
agents.computerCritique: Carve rolling diagonal cobalt/violet ridge contours, a luminous pale-ochre horizon mist band along the foothills, and billowing silver-green curved strokes across the olive crowns.
agents.v2Fix: Painted 3,835 diagonal ridge and curved foliage strokes with dark-blue crest lines and luminous horizon mist, improving regional SSIM from 0.6975 to 0.9094 (ΔE 11.67 → 3.43).
